newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares boosted by results, merger news.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares boosted by results, merger news.

text.p: Most banking shares were higher on the Estonian stock exchange on Thursday as the market responded to the first batch of June results, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 47.9 million kroons with the Talse index 1.01 percent higher at 279.03.

Dealers said the results released by Hoiupank and Hansapank were broadly in line with market expectations while Tallinna Pank's, which showed a June profit of 4.4 million kroons, were a little disappointing.
But Tallinna's price was pushed up 0.65 kroons to 63.10 kroons on news that it planned to acquire a 100 percent stake in Saules Bank, one of the largest banks in Latvia.
Hoiupank's June result, a record 18.8 milion kroons, was released 30 minutes before the bourse closed. It finished 2.5 kroons higher at 154.00 kroons in trade of 7.1 million kroons.
"If they continue like this, they will have to revise heir profit forecast upwards," one analyst said.
Hansapank released its results after the bourse closed. It showed a June profit of 23.1 kroons compared to 41.8 million kroons in May.
Hansa saw trade of 12.1 million kroons to rise 2.05 kroons to 149.40 kroons.
Forekspank was the most active stock in trade of 15.4 million kroons to close at 194.75 kroons, up 0.35 kroons.
"There was a lot of speculative selling and buying interest ahead of the release of its results," one trader said.
